environment.description: Kafka consumer deployed in EKS cluster. Messages on 'user-lookup-requests' topic are produced by a lightweight HTTP proxy (nginx reverse proxy) that accepts POST /api/v1/user-lookup with a 'username' field in the body. The proxy forwards the raw username string as the Kafka message value without transformation. No schema validation or input sanitization is performed at the ingress layer. Any authenticated client with a valid JWT can produce messages to the topic via the HTTP endpoint.

config.kafka: MSK cluster, topic user-lookup-requests, no message validation
config.ldap: OpenLDAP 2.6, anonymous read enabled on subtree
